title: When Agentic Trust Crosses Organizational Boundaries: Structural Externalization and a Reference Model for Trust Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2609.22961v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly invoke tools, services, data, and other agents across organizational boundaries, yet a relying party cannot assess a delegated action solely from producing-domain controls and records. This paper develops Trustworthiness as a Service (TaaS) through a synthesis of trustworthy-AI governance, agent security, distributed trust management, identity, provenance, assurance, and control-plane research. The analytical unit is a cross-domain reliance proposition that names the issuer, subject and action, relying party, administrative boundary, evidence dependencies, adverse condition, and required verification or adjudication semantics. The three-condition structural-externalization diagnostic identifies propositions that depend on multiple domains, require producer-independent reliance, and must remain reviewable after revocation, failure, conflicting records, or dispute. translated_title: 当代理信任跨越组织边界时：结构性外化与信任证据参考模型
translated_abstract: 智能代理系统越来越多地跨越组织边界调用工具、服务、数据和其他代理，然而依赖方无法仅凭产生域的控制措施和记录来评估一项委托操作。本文通过综合可信AI治理、代理安全、分布式信任管理、身份、溯源、保证以及控制平面等研究领域，提出了可信即服务。其分析单元是跨域依赖命题，该命题明确了签发者、主体与操作、依赖方、管理边界、证据依赖关系、不利条件以及所需的验证或裁决语义。三条件结构性外化诊断方法用于识别那些依赖多个域、需要独立于生产者的信任关系、且在撤销、失败、记录冲突或争议发生后仍必须保持可审查的命题。针对此类命题，本文规定了一种……
tldr: 本文提出可信即服务框架和三条件结构性外化诊断方法，解决智能代理系统跨组织边界行动时的信任评估难题，并给出信任证据的参考模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Trustworthiness as a Service (TaaS), a three-condition structural-externalization diagnostic, and a reference model for trust evidence to address trust assessment when agentic systems act across organizational boundaries.
